name: Word Comment Export
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Write %% comment %% right after a word to turn it into a Word comment on export.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Word Comment Export is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your writing.
